sections.heading: Your tutorial gear
sections.body: Crafting granted three equipment pieces: Tutorial Sword, Tutorial Chest, and Tutorial Ring. These are intentionally weaker than normal crafted gear, but strong enough to begin Lumo Ruins.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Open the Equipment tab in Inventory and equip one tutorial gear piece to complete First Steps.

sections.heading: Finishing
sections.body: Once one tutorial gear piece is equipped, First Steps completes and normal Shenic combat areas become available.
